warnings: Ring-beam (อะเส) level plan. Members with no printed level suffix are the main wall-top ring (RB1/RB2, level not printed on this sheet -- S-07 sections carry it); '+3.75' members frame the two SX sunshade slabs over the veranda-band extensions; '+3.65' members frame the porch and carport roof slabs. Levels recorded in level_m per schema §8, element_id kept as the bare printed mark (RB1/RB1A/RB2).

Vertical members in the E-D band at this level sit at 1', 1, 2, 2', 3, 4, 4' (pixel-scanned) -- NOT at the 1''/3' bathroom lines, which exist only at S-04 floor level. Conversely the 2' line (x 4.80, printed 1.60 west of grid 3) and B' line (printed 2.50 above row A) exist ONLY at this level. The grid master carries all of them house-wide.

DOUBLE LABELS: 'RB1/RB1' (grid 1 and grid 4, rows E-D) and 'RB1/RB1+3.65' (row C bays 2-3 and 3-4) were each read as TWO collinear members at different levels -- the main ring plus the adjacent lower roof-slab edge -- because in each case the lower slab's other three edges are explicitly labelled with the +3.65/+3.75 suffix and the box must close geometrically. Every such element carries a double_label confidence flag; see phase_note for the Stage 2 check.
The 'โล่ง' (open) tags in all main-house bays mean no slab at ring level there -- the roof structure above is on S-06 (แปลนโครงหลังคา, Stage 2 scope, pattern roof_plan per the Stage 0 manifest).
No drawing break lines on this sheet (same explicit check as the other S-sheets; the printed 1.10/1.60/0.80/2.50 local dims all reconcile with pixel geometry at the uniform 78.75 px/m scale).
Both grid chains printed here close identically to S-02 (3x3.20 = 9.60; 4.00+2.00+3.60+1.80+3.15 = 14.55).
